security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG or KVM, when mseccfg.MML is set and a PMP entry matches, the smepmp_operation switch table in pmp_hart_has_privs() (target/riscv/pmp.c:445-490) must exactly match the normative MML truth table. Any deviation — a missing case, wrong privilege mask, or incorrect default fallthrough — causes M-mode to gain execute access on Shared-Regions where the spec mandates M-mode=no-permissions (smepmp_operation 4-8), or causes S/U-mode to gain read/write access on M-mode-only regions (smepmp_operation 0-1, 8-13). This is a bit-exact correctness requirement: QEMU software-emulates the PMP in TCG and must route KVM PMP exits identically.
security_spec.summary: Smepmp MML truth table switch/case in pmp_hart_has_privs() must be bitwise-identical to the normative spec truth table; a single wrong case value grants M-mode execute or S/U-mode read/write on regions the spec denies, constituting privilege escalation in both TCG and KVM-accelerated guests
